name: Shears
location: Route 2 Before Forest (Lumberjack Quest house, accessed via Diglett's Cave from Vermilion City in Chapter 3)
notes: Allows cutting small trees in the overworld without knowing the move Cut.

name: Lantern
notes: Permanently illuminates dark caves like Rock Tunnel without knowing Flash.

name: Pickaxe
notes: Smashes cracked boulders in overworld without knowing Rock Smash.

name: Dolly
notes: Pushes round heavy boulders in caves without knowing Strength.

name: Surfboard
notes: Allows traversing water bodies without knowing Surf.

name: Teleporter
notes: Fast-travel teleport to any previously visited Pokémon Center. (Note: The move Teleport also allows fast-travel to any visited Center as soon as you have the Thunder Badge!).

name: Scuba Gear
notes: Allows diving into deep sea trenches and underwater ruins.

name: Climbing Gear
notes: Allows scaling rocky cliffs with footprints.
